caption: the psp naruto pair - heroes 3's roster war and akatsuki rising's beat-em-up story mode in one row.
about: This row carries the two psp naruto shippuden action games western players actually got. Ultimate ninja heroes 3 (2009) is the roster fighter: over fifty characters, 4-player ad-hoc battles and the series' support-character system. Akatsuki rising (2009) takes the same cast into a side-scrolling beat-em-up with akatsuki as playable unlockables - the closest the franchise came to a proper action brawler on handheld.
No windows builds exist, so the platform is psp - played through ppsspp, roms sourced from romsfun.
